A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RLAIF-V work and contain readable main text and Appendices A–F. Their equations, tables, figures, and supplementary examples can be matched, with no material gaps limiting comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original RLAIF-V model evaluations, ablations, and inference-time experiments in Section 3, plus RefoMB evaluation and reliability analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains original RLAIF-V experimental results in Section 3 and the supplementary RefoMB results, reliability analyses, and qualitative comparisons.

M1.justification: Sections 2.1–2.4 retain the same deconfounded response generation, divide-and-conquer annotation, iterative DPO training, and length-normalized self-feedback for best-of-N selection. No method component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: The training sources and six evaluation benchmarks—Object HalBench, MMHal-Bench, MHumanEval, AMBER, RefoMB, and MMStar—are unchanged. RefoMB retains the same eight task categories and appendix evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same methods, including VCD, OPERA, CCA-LLaVA, Silkie, RLHF-V, and GPT-4V in Table 1. Comparator membership also matches in the ablations, inference-time analyses, and appendix RefoMB tables.

E3.justification: Both versions retain the same model configurations, four iterations of four DPO epochs, RefoMB split of 99/261 instructions, and Table 1 best-of-N sample counts of 32/16. Evaluation metrics, evaluator procedures, and experimental controls are unchanged.

E4.justification: The response-generation and annotation ablations in Tables 2–3 and feedback combination, transfer, and inference-scaling analyses in Figures 3–5 are retained. Appendix analyses of RefoMB reliability, claim aggregation, hallucination distributions, and qualitative examples also match.

E5.justification: Seed and sampling descriptions remain unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests, and v3 introduces no new statistical reporting practice.

E6.justification: Numerical results and plotted and qualitative findings match. For example, Table 1 retains Object HalBench response hallucination rates of 10.5% for RLAIF-V 7B and 4.5% for RLAIF-V 12B; appendix Tables 6–7 and Figures 12–13 are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The claim-scoring and preference-pair definitions, DPO reward identity in Equation (1), and length-normalized reward are unchanged. Appendix C.1 retains the same alternative aggregation formula; no mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about open-source alignment, high-quality feedback generation, inference-time self-feedback, and self-alignment achieving super-GPT-4V trustworthiness. Their scientific scope and strength do not change.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning confounding, feedback transfer, complementarity, and response-length bias are retained. Appendix F states the same limitations concerning training costs and remaining hallucinations, without new applicability qualifications.

D1.justification: Section 3.1 and Appendix C retain the same hyperparameters, hardware, timings, claim-splitting model details, and prompts. The code, dataset, and model links and the stated RefoMB release instructions are unchanged.

R1.justification: Both versions contain the same 80 cited works and retain the research positioning in Section 4 and Appendix A. Changes to bibliography spacing and citation back-reference page numbers reflect typesetting and text reflow.

P1.justification: The author affiliations are revised, including adding Shanghai Qi Zhi Institute and simplifying institutional descriptions. The scientific prose, terminology, section order, and appendix organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The affiliation block becomes more compact, and spacing changes reflow text across columns and pages; for example, Section 2 begins on PDF page 2 instead of page 3. Figures 1–13 and Tables 1–13 retain their content and display structure.

improvement.justification: v3 updates affiliations and modestly adjusts typesetting while preserving the method, experimental evidence, appendix analyses, claims, limitations, and reproducibility information. These administrative and presentation edits produce no meaningful overall change in scientific rigor, clarity, or usefulness.
